title: Merge the intervals
statement:
You get a list of closed intervals [l, r]. Merge every pair of intervals that overlap or touch, repeatedly, until no two remaining intervals overlap or touch. Two intervals [a, b] and [c, d] with a <= c overlap or touch when c <= b, so [1, 3] and [3, 5] merge into [1, 5], but [1, 2] and [3, 4] stay apart.

Input: the first line holds n (1 <= n <= 10000). Each of the next n lines holds two integers l and r (0 <= l <= r <= 1000000000). The intervals come in any order.

Output: first a line with the number of merged intervals k, then k lines each holding l and r of one merged interval separated by a space, in increasing order of l.

Example
Input:
4
8 10
1 3
2 6
15 18
Output:
3
1 6
8 10
15 18
